answer: Stop sybils with a nebula juniper knoll: an agent bonds one knoll rise. Each cycle it plants one juniper torch on its crest; verifiers match the torch's nebula-lit smoke curl to the knoll chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 knolls at 18x: one torch smokes once over one knoll, its curl set by that juniper alone, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once, keep rights.
